run_geomancer_on_synthetic_manifolds: run GEOMANCER on a product of synthetic manifolds like S^2 x S^2 using the CLI
generate_product_manifold_data: generate synthetic data points from a product of SO(n) and sphere manifolds with make_product_manifold
compute_so_tangent_basis: compute an orthonormal tangent space basis for a given SO(n) orthonormal matrix using make_so_tangent
compute_sphere_tangent_basis: compute the tangent space basis for a point on a sphere using make_sphere_tangent
compute_true_tangents_for_manifold: compute orthonormal tangent bases for each submanifold in a product manifold using make_true_tangents
